select doi.platform_order_id, doi.source_platform, doi.shop_name, case when doi.currency_rate != 0 then round(doi.order_fee/doi.currency_rate,4) else 0 end as itemTotal, doi.order_fee as cnyRealTimeAmount, case when doi.currency_rate != 0 then round(doi.order_fee/doi.currency_rate * doi.cny_settle_rate,4) else 0 end as cny_settle_amount, doi.buyer_name, doi.man_phone, doi.second_phone, doi.man_street, doi.second_street, doi.country_name_cn, case when doi.order_state = 2 then '配货中' when doi.order_state = 3 then '已发货' when doi.order_state = 4 then '已完成' when doi.order_state = 5 then '已作废' else '' end order_state_name, case when doi.correction_status = 2 then '配货中' when doi.correction_status = 3 then '已发货' when doi.correction_status = 4 then '已完成' when doi.correction_status = 5 then '已作废' else '' end correction_status_name, doi.correction_status, doi.create_time, doi.platform_create_time, doi.platform_order_id, doi.delivery_time, doi.charge_name, doi.currency_code, doi.dept_name, doi2.sku_no, doi2.item_name, doi2.sell_price_origin, doi2.quantity, round(doi2.sell_price_origin * doi2.quantity,2) as sellAmountOrigin from dmp_order_info doi left join dmp_order_item_split doi2 on doi.id = doi2.order_id
and doi.platform_order_id ILIKE concat('%',#{params.platformOrderId}::text,'%')
and doi.shop_name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.shopName}::text,'%')
and doi.platform_order_id ILIKE concat('%',#{params.platformName}::text,'%')
and doi.order_state = #{params.orderState}
and doi.platform_create_time >= #{params.createTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.platform_create_time <= #{params.createTime_end}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time >= #{params.deliveryTime_begin}::timestamp
and doi.delivery_time <= #{params.deliveryTime_end}::timestamp
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_currency_rate),2) AS salesAmount
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_cny_settle_rate),2) AS salesAmount
round(SUM (o.sales_amount),2) AS salesAmount
FROM dmp_order_delivery_report AS o
FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o

SELECT #{rangeVO.startValue} AS startValue, #{rangeVO.endValue} AS endValue, COALESCE(sum(o.sales_qty),0) AS salesQuantity,
COALESCE(round(SUM (o.sales_amount_currency_rate),2),0) AS saleAmount
COALESCE(round(SUM (o.sales_amount_cny_settle_rate),2),0) AS saleAmount
COALESCE(round(SUM (o.sales_amount),2),0) AS saleAmount
FROM dmp_order_delivery_report AS o
FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o
and o.sell_price BETWEEN #{rangeVO.startValue} AND #{rangeVO.endValue}

SELECT SUM(coalesce(doit.quantity, 0)) AS salesVolume
FROM dmp_order_delivery_report AS o
FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o

select
o.dept_id as typeId,
o.charge_id as typeId,
o.shop_name as typeName,
o.category_id as typeId,
o.sku_no as typeName,
to_char(ddd.date_time,'MM') as month,
round(sum(COALESCE(o.sales_amount_currency_rate,0)),2) as value
SUM (COALESCE(o.sales_qty,0)) as value
FROM dmp_order_delivery_report AS o right join dmp_date_dimension ddd on o.date_day = ddd.date_day and ddd.is_deleted = false
FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o right join dmp_date_dimension ddd on o.date_day = ddd.date_day and ddd.is_deleted = false
group by month
,o.dept_id
,o.charge_id
,o.shop_name
,o.category_id
,o.sku_no
